findings: Every meal was followed by its own first home arrival within 14 yards before the next hunt or meal, with measured XY movement and a fixed record home.
One return crossed 17.63009 to 12 yards with 5.725 yards sampled movement, but its short RETURN_HOME phase was between two-second samples.
Two HUNTING phases were between samples; FEEDING and actual hunger reduction were captured for all 30 meals.
One deer had living_role:null for one sample immediately after respawn, with identity and AI control intact; PREY state resumed in the next sample.
The final strict return reached home in the last sample, so its subsequent ambient activity is outside this recording.
limits: Sampled evidence on the current flat map; this does not test slopes, obstacles, larger populations, groups or model advice.

Observer v4 does not export runtime GUID, life incarnation, player count or kill credit. It cannot by itself prove a playerless run, uninterrupted runtime incarnation or absence of external intervention.
home is the stored agent home; home_distance uses the runtime creature home. Exact runtime home equality is a separate diagnostic.

A replay requiring 3600 seconds of continuous fresh sample coverage is inconclusive because a 3600-second run at two-second sampling contains 3598 seconds between first and last sample; the deployed 900-second policy passes.
